zoe: Heads-up - onboarding QA found duplicated payments from the sampleapp when a token refresh overlaps with a 429 and the client retries. Minimal logs below.
michael: Can you paste the log snippet and repro frequency?
zoe: Repro in CI ~15% when token TTL is tiny. Logs: 
```
WARN req=op-aa 429 retry_after=0.35 attempt=1
INFO auth token refreshed
INFO req=op-aa retry attempt=2 -> 200 created id=pay_001
INFO req=op-aa processed -> created id=pay_002
```
hen: Looks like the client makes a new request_id each try so server-side dedupe misses it. Sampleapp uses body.request_id = uuid() inline which runs per request.
michael: Short-term patch: persist request_id across retries in sampleapp. Medium-term: SDK should optionally add an Idempotency-Key header for mutating calls unless the app provides one. Also change backoff to full jitter to avoid retry clumping around token rotation.
zoe: I patched sampleapp to stash request_id in the retry context and CI dupes dropped to zero in 200 runs.
qa-bot: CI job payments-onboard #612 completed: 200 runs, 0 duplicates after patch.
hen: SDK proposal: defaults -> autoIdempotency=true, env opt-out REDWOOD_SDK_AUTOIDEMPOTENCY=false, backoff.strategy=full_jitter, backoff.base_ms=450. Delay formula = rand(0, base * 2^attempt). Emit anonymized telemetry boolean when header injected.
michael: Security note: document header retention/logging and allow enterprise opt-out. Server teams should expose safeReplayWindowMs per route (recommended 5m for payments).
zoe: Action items: 1) I'll open the sampleapp PR (small change) 2) Hen will draft SDK PR with opt-out and jitter change 3) Add an e2e that simulates token TTL=1s + single 429 and assert only one charge.
hen: Will tag eng-security and docs. I'll include tests and a config flag.
michael: Once canaried in sampleapp run the CI harness; if dupes remain tweak base_ms or server dedupe TTL.
zoe: Thanks y'all - tricky DX edge but easy to mitigate with stable request ids + jitter + optional SDK idempotency.
